+def _dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages)
+        if name_order == "descending":
+            names.reverse()
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        choices = [[None] + list(packages[name]) for name in names]
+        best_key = None
+        best_versions = None
+
+        for assignment in product(*choices):
+            selected = {name: row for name, row in zip(names, assignment) if row is not None}
+            valid = True
+            for name, bounds in data["roots"].items():
+                row = selected.get(name)
+                if row is None or not bounds[0] <= row["version"] <= bounds[1]:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+
+            reached = set()
+            edges = {}
+            pending = list(data["roots"])
+            while pending and valid:
+                name = pending.pop()
+                if name in reached:
+                    continue
+                reached.add(name)
+                row = selected.get(name)
+                if row is None:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                version = row["version"]
+                if version in blocked.get(name, []) or (name in pins and pins[name] != version):
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                active = [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                          if not dep.get("feature") or dep["feature"] in features]
+                edges[name] = []
+                for dep in active:
+                    other = dep["name"]
+                    child = selected.get(other)
+                    if child is None or not dep["min"] <= child["version"] <= dep["max"]:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    edges[name].append(other)
+                    pending.append(other)
+            if not valid or reached != set(selected):
+                continue
+
+            finished, active_nodes = set(), set()
+            def visit(node):
+                if node in active_nodes:
+                    return False
+                if node in finished:
+                    return True
+                active_nodes.add(node)
+                if any(not visit(child) for child in edges.get(node, [])):
+                    return False
+                active_nodes.remove(node)
+                finished.add(node)
+                return True
+            if not all(visit(node) for node in edges):
+                continue
+
+            vector = tuple(selected[n]["version"] if n in selected else -1 for n in names)
+            if best_key is None or (vector < best_key if preference == "minimum" else vector > best_key):
+                best_key = vector
+                best_versions = {n: row["version"] for n, row in selected.items()}
+        if best_versions is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": best_versions}
+    return solve
